## HIGH IMPACT

No high-impact breaking changes were identified in this release. None of the three styling-relevant files introduce renamed CSS custom properties, removed shadow DOM elements, changed component element names, or restructured slots/parts that the ha-lcars theme currently targets.

## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `hui-energy-usage-graph-card` (Energy Usage Graph Card)

**What changed:** `src/panels/lovelace/cards/energy/hui-energy-usage-graph-card.ts` was refactored to extract a new `buildCombinedUsedGrid` helper (in the new `energy-usage-graph-used-grid.ts` file). The key behavioral change is that a "combined used_grid" legend series is now conditionally omitted when it has no data points — specifically, the guard `if (statIdsByCat.solar)` block was extended to skip adding an empty combined series for multi-source battery charging scenarios. Additionally, the chart logic was modified so that `undefined` is returned from `buildCombinedUsedGrid` when no combined series is needed, causing the chart to skip adding an empty legend item.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The ha-lcars theme does not directly inject CSS into `hui-energy-usage-graph-card`'s shadow DOM via card-mod, and does not reference the `--energy-grid-return-color` or any other `colorPropertyMap` variables (e.g., `--energy-grid-return-color`, `--energy-solar-color`, etc.) from the card's internal `colorPropertyMap`. However, the legend rendering inside the chart may shift — specifically, legend items that were previously rendered as empty placeholders (and thus potentially styled/sized as empty slots in the chart layout) will now be absent entirely. If any user of ha-lcars has applied card-mod overrides to `hui-energy-usage-graph-card` that target legend-count-dependent layout (e.g., nth-child selectors on legend entries, or fixed-width assumptions about the legend), those overrides could shift.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed in the core ha-lcars theme source. If individual users have custom card-mod overrides on the energy graph card that depend on a fixed number of legend items, they should audit those rules. No changes to `preamble.yaml` or `defaults.yaml` are required.

---

### Component: `hass-router-page` (Router Page / Panel Navigation)

**What changed:** `src/layouts/hass-router-page.ts` gained a new `itemId` route option. When `itemId: true` is set on a route, the page element is now destroyed and recreated whenever the "tail" path segment (the item ID portion of the URL) changes, rather than calling `updatePageEl` on the existing element. This affects how panels like the automation editor, script editor, and scene editor behave when navigating between items.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** The ha-lcars theme injects CSS into several config panels via card-mod selectors such as:
- `"ha-config-automation $ ha-automation-editor $"` (`.sortable-ghost`, `.sortable-drag` background colors)
- `"ha-config-script $ ha-script-editor $"` (same)
- `"ha-config-scene $ hass-tabs-subpage $"` (`div.bottom-bar` `--header-height`)

If `ha-config-automation`, `ha-config-script`, or `ha-config-scene` adopt `itemId: true` routing (which would be the motivation for the fix mentioned in release notes: "Fix editor state leaking when switching automations, scripts, or scenes"), the child editor element (`ha-automation-editor`, `ha-script-editor`) will be torn down and recreated on navigation. Card-mod rules injected into the shadow DOM of these components may need to re-apply on each recreation. In practice, card-mod already handles re-injection on element reconnection, so this is likely tolerable — but there is a window during the teardown/recreation cycle where styles may flash or be absent.

**Suggested fix:** Monitor for visual flicker when switching between automation/script/scene items. No immediate code change to ha-lcars is required. If flicker is observed, consider whether the affected card-mod rules (`.sortable-ghost`/`.sortable-drag` in `ha-config-automation` and `ha-config-script`) need to be moved to a higher-level selector that survives element recreation.

### Component: `hass-router-page` (New `itemId` Route Option)

**What changed:** The new `itemId?: boolean` property on `RouteOptions` enables per-item page recreation in the router. This is a routing infrastructure addition.

**What it affects in ha-lcars:** No CSS variables, element selectors, or shadow DOM structures are added or removed. The ha-lcars theme has no rules that target `hass-router-page` directly.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. Informational only — see MEDIUM section above for the indirect styling implication on child panels.
